name: Sadistic Gamers Part 1 Kateikyoushi Play

source:
Tutor girl comes by. But if quiz questions are answered correctly, then it may become time for main character to teach her something.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
